title: Buyback Insider Conviction Pipeline Input
description: Finds recent 8-K share repurchase announcements for your tickers, attaches insider open-market buying in a window around each announcement, scores conviction 0 to 100, and tiers each catalyst.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stock tickers to scan for buyback 8-K announcements, e.g. ["AAPL", "OLN", "EQT"].

buybackKeywords.title: Buyback keywords
buybackKeywords.description: Words an 8-K must contain to count as a buyback announcement. EDGAR full-text matches these in the filing body.

maxAgeDays.title: Max age (days)
maxAgeDays.description: Ignore filings older than this many days. 120 = about a quarter.

insiderWindowDays.title: Insider window (days)
insiderWindowDays.description: Count insider buys and sells within this many days on either side of the announcement.

includeInsider.title: Include insider buying
includeInsider.description: Attach insider open-market buys and sells around each announcement. Turn off for announcements only.

minScore.title: Minimum conviction score
minScore.description: Drop and never charge filings scoring below this 0 to 100 threshold. 0 keeps every buyback announcement.

maxFilingsPerCompany.title: Max filings per company
maxFilingsPerCompany.description: Cap on buyback filings returned per ticker, most recent first.

maxFilingsTotal.title: Max filings total
maxFilingsTotal.description: Cap on filings scored across all tickers.

userAgent.title: SEC User-Agent (optional)
userAgent.description: EDGAR asks for a descriptive User-Agent that includes an email. Defaults to a generic scrapemint value if left blank.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. EDGAR does not need a proxy, so the default is no proxy.
